{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Dark City |characters=ダークシティ |japanese=Dark City |image=Dark City.png |imagesize=250px |region=Kanto |epicode=EP042 |episode=Showdown at Dark City }} '''Dark City''' (Japanese: '''ダークシティ''' ''Dark City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]] found in between the {{safari|Kanto}} and [[Cinnabar Island]]. The city does not have an official [[Gym]], but two unofficial rival Gyms seek the wealth and glory that comes with having one. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrive in ''[[EP042|Showdown at Dark City]]'', the city was shown to be in disrepair because of the constant warfare from the competing Gyms. As a result, the residents of this town detest and fear Pokémon Trainers. A local restaurant owner stated that the Kaz Gym hadn't paid for food in over two years. The leaders' main Pokémon for the {{DL|Gym|Yas Gym}} and {{DL|Gym|Kaz Gym}} are {{p|Scyther}} and {{p|Electabuzz}} respectively. For this reason, their followers do not appear to join for personal connection with a particular type of Pokémon, unlike in most Gyms, and the actions of [[Yas]] and [[Kaz]] appear to intimidate and recruit Trainers into joining their Gym, lest they join the rival Gym. After [[Nurse Joy|an agent]] for the [[Pokémon Inspection Agency]] determined that neither Gym was worthy of being an official Gym due to using Pokémon as gang tools, the two rivals agreed to stop their street fighting and work together to reconstruct Dark City. ==Gallery== {|style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|RG}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|RG}}" |-style="background:#{{colorschemelight|RG}}" !style="{{roundytl|5px}}"|Yas Gym !style="{{roundytr|5px}}"|Kaz Gym |-style="background:#fff" |[[File:Yas Gym.png|200px]] |[[File:Kaz Gym.png|200px]] |} ==Pokémon seen in Dark City== {|style="margin:auto; width: 100%" |- |{{ActivePoké|Kaz|Electabuzz|Kaz Electabuzz.png|disp=Kaz's Electabuzz|Electric|link=Kaz}} |{{ActivePoké|Kaz|Raticate|Dark City Various.png|Normal|link=no}} |{{ActivePoké|Kaz|Golem|Dark City Various.png|Rock|Ground|link=no}} |- |{{ActivePoké|Kaz|Kingler|Dark City Kingler.png|Water|link=no}} |{{ActivePoké|Kaz|Rhydon|Dark City Hitmonchan Rhydon.png|Ground|Rock|link=no}} |{{ActivePoké|Yas|Scyther|Yas Scyther.png|disp=Yas's Scyther|Bug|Flying|link=Yas}} |- |{{ActivePoké|Yas|Mankey|Dark City Various.png|Fighting|link=no}} |{{ActivePoké|Yas|Machoke|Dark City Various.png|Fighting|link=no}} |{{ActivePoké|Yas|Hitmonchan|Dark City Hitmonchan Rhydon.png|Fighting|link=no}} ♂ |- |{{ActivePoké|Yas|Hitmonlee|Dark City Various.png|Fighting|link=no}} ♂ |} ==In other languages== {{Langtable|color={{colorschemelight|RG}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|RG}} |zh_yue=黑暗市 ''{{tt|Hāak'am Síh|Dark City}}'' |zh_cmn=黑暗市 ''{{tt|Hēi'àn Shì|Dark City}}'' |cs=Temné město |da=Dark City |fr_eu=Sombreville |he=בעיר האופל |hu=Árnyékváros |it=Dark City
